admission: No candidate probability publication unless a future untouched block and prospective reliability support calibration and improvements over baseline. Every prospective slot retains fixed absolute targets and logs due outcome without tuning.
baseline: training class frequency, fixed for each future block
challenger: simple L2 logistic regression C=0.03 using only trailing closed-candle returns 4h/24h/72h, realized absolute return 24h/72h and log-volume ratio 24h/168h; scaler fit on training only
historical_mapping: Scale both fixed barrier distances by past anchor close / reference_snapshot.price_usdt; use subsequent closed hourly high and low; both touched in same first hour is ambiguous; no intrahour ordering invented.
missing_or_partial_hour: exclude anchor/label windows with gaps, duplicates or partial candles; no interpolation
purge_rule: For each scenario remove any training anchor whose anchor_time + horizon_hours >= 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z; this corrects boundary leakage discovered after v1 metrics. No threshold, feature, regularization, or target changes.
purpose: Compare lower-first, upper-first, neither and same-hour ambiguous for a cash-holder's entry-window question; no trade authority
